newsitem.title: USA: Stocks resume downtrend in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Stocks resume downtrend in early trading.

text.p: Stocks opened lower Friday, continuing a sharp sell-off that began late in Thursday's session.

The Dow Jones industrial average, which plummtted 94 points Thursday in the busiest trading day ever on the New York Stock Exchange, was down 24 points at 6,731 about 10 minutes after the opening bell. Early volume totalled about 33 million shares.
Market bellwether International Business Machines Corp., which fell $6.25 in Thursday's sell-off, was up 25 cents at $152 a share.
Pepsico Inc. led the actives list, trading 37.5 cents higher at $34.625 one day after it announced the spinoff of its fast-food businesses. The stock gained $3.50 Thursday.
Cascade Communications Corp., which provides products for computer communications systems, fell $21 a share to $43.375 on Nasdaq one day after reporting disappointing fourth-quarter results.
